context:
Decision gate (owner): approve this offer before any upstream contact.

Verification rubric: (1) the reduced change applies to current upstream main; (2) its dialect tests pass on the real engine; (3) the fork's downstream contract tests pass after the patches.json edit.

Guardrails: no pull request, issue or comment on tobymao/sqlglot until the owner approves this specific offer in this item's context; the offered change must be the fork patch reduced to upstream-only behaviour; the patch stays carried in patches.json until upstream merges and a refresh retires it with equivalence evidence.

Upstream rules (tobymao/sqlglot AGENTS.md): Conventional Commits title ending with the agent model ([CLAUDE], [CODEX]); minimal scope; tests in tests/dialects that run on the real engine; no fork-only behaviour or benchbox package references.

Owner approval 2026-11-19 (Joe Harris, choice dialog): approved for upstream offer to tobymao/sqlglot. Scope chosen: the postgres-extract-return-types / sqlite-date-extraction pair plus the generic SQLite fixes (sqlite-set-operation-operands, empty-group-by-generator with sqlite-empty-group-by, sqlite-date-day-arithmetic). Pacing: open independent PRs together; open dependent ones after their prerequisite merges. PRs are opened as joeharris76 from BenchBox-dev/benchbox-sqlglot branches, titles end with [CLAUDE]. Offered together with sqlite-empty-group-by as one upstream PR: the base flag plus SQLite opting out, since upstream would not take an unused flag.

2026-11-19: offered with sqlite-empty-group-by as https://github.com/tobymao/sqlglot/issues/9270, fork commit 2eb247ef (branch upstream/sqlite-empty-group-by). SQLite only; the fork's Snowflake/Spark 2 settings and the pre-3.39 HAVING rewrite stay carried. Verified on SQLite 3.54 vs DuckDB (empty and non-empty tables); test_sqlite, test_optimizer, test_executor, test_transpile pass. tobymao/sqlglot now accepts pull requests only from collaborators (repo setting pull_request_creation_policy=collaborators_only, observed 2026-11-19; createPullRequest refused for joeharris76), so with the owner's approval (choice dialog, 2026-11-19) the offer was filed as an issue linking the ready fork commit. Fork patches.json records it in BenchBox-dev/benchbox-sqlglot#120. Next: when upstream fixes the issue (their own commit or ours), a refresh retires the fork patch with equivalence evidence; until then the patch stays carried.
